text.p: Anheuser-Busch and Grupo Modelo of Mexico are still talking about a deal to increase the former's stake in the Mexican company, a statement released by Anheuser's Mexico office said on Wednesday.

"During the board meeting of Grupo Modelo, the Mexican controlling shareholders and Anheuser-Busch exchanged points of view on the matters that have held up the process of increasing the U.S. firm's stake" in Modelo, the statement said.
"As the Investment Agreement foresees, both parties agreed to make their best efforts to resolve the prevailing differences in the next 60 days."

"These differences are related to technical aspects concerning determination of the price of the shares which Anheuser-Busch has optioned and do not reflect any disagreement about commercial policies or practices."
The statement quoted August Busch, chairman of Anheuser, as saying after the meeting:

"Mexico is for us an important commercial destination and a key to all our globalization strategy as well as for the strengthening of the relationship we have with the Mexican-American community in the United States."
